title: Execution finisher I'm working on
author: Sudden_Bite_4808
selftext:
Sharing a melee execution I'm working on for my dark fantasy action RPG, The Last God (built in UE5). While prototyping the combat and progression systems, I used generative AI for placeholder illustration art on the website/ability cards before final handcrafted art.

Disclosure: There are AI placeholder illustration images on the website.

Game Website: [https://thelastgod.vercel.app/combat](https://thelastgod.vercel.app/combat)

comments.author: West_Satisfaction299
comments.body: It looks good but definitely can see places where the execution jumps steps but still very cool.

comments.author: Fickle_Composer_4506
comments.body: So how much of it was coded and how long did it take. I'm not trying to hate but trying to grasp how much better ai is getting.

replies.author: Sudden_Bite_4808
replies.body: I coded every single node in blueprints. If you don’t believe me that’s fine. I started learning like 3 years ago. But I had no idea what I was doing for the first year. So it depends on how advanced you are, and if you build modular and data driven systems or not. Most beginners hardcore everything. A tutorial series that helped alot was a guy by the name of Ali Elzohiery. He’s amazing and explains really well.  If you actually wanted to know.

replies.author: Fickle_Composer_4506
replies.body: I trust you just scary how fast ai developed lol. looks good so far.
